_notes.base_url: Full public root URL, no trailing slash. Used for canonicals, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and JSON-LD.
_notes.tracking_url: After an affiliate program approves us, paste the full tracking link here. Every element with data-affiliate="<key>" gets this href on the next build. Leave empty to use the plain public url.
_notes.states: Two-letter code -> full name. Every page's "state" must be listed here. The state name's slug is the state hub URL (/indiana/).
_notes.legal_help: Free or low-cost legal help. NOT paid partners: never put tracking links here. Verify every URL loads on the day you add it; drop any that don't. Add each new state's statewide legal aid site when its first page is published. aba_free_legal_answers = whether the state appears on abafreelegalanswers.org's participating-state list.
_notes.base_path: URL path the site is served under. Every root-relative href/src is prefixed with it at build time.
_notes.external_links_verified_manually: URLs that block scripted checks but were confirmed working another way (WebFetch or a browser). check.py --external reports them as WARN instead of ERR. Re-confirm them when you touch a page that uses them.

external_links_verified_manually.https://www.lawhelp.org/: Server drops non-browser connections from the box (curl HTTP/2 CANCEL). Loaded fine with WebFetch on 2026-10-27; LSC's official page also links to it.
